lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhodahu kapat hoi niravairaa so prabh sa(n)g nihaare ||
lines.translation: Abandon your deception, and go beyond vengeance; see God who is always with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach dhan vanajahu sach dhan sa(n)chahu kabahoo na aavahu haare ||1||
lines.translation: Deal only in this true wealth and gather in this true wealth, and you shall never suffer loss. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaat kharachat kichh nikhutat naahee aganat bhare bha(n)daare ||
lines.translation: Eating and consuming it, it is never exhausted; God's treasures are overflowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੫੭॥੮੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sobhaa sa(n)g jaavahu paarabraham kai duaare ||2||57||80||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, you shall go home to the Court of the Supreme Lord God with honor and respect. ||2||57||80||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh jee mohi kavan anaath bichaaraa ||
lines.translation: O Dear God, I am wretched and helpless!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਰਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan mool te maanukh kariaa ihu parataap tuhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: From what source did you create humans? This is Your Glorious Grandeur. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee praan sarab ke daate gun kahe na jaahi apaaraa ||
lines.translation: You are the Giver of the soul and the breath of life to all; Your Infinite Glories cannot be spoken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾਂ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ke preetam srab pratipaalak sarab ghataa(n) aadhaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: You are the Beloved Lord of all, the Cherisher of all, the Support of all hearts. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: koi na jaanai tumaree gat mit aapahi ek pasaaraa ||
lines.translation: No one knows Your state and extent. You alone created the expanse of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਵ ਬੈਠਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੫੮॥੮੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadh naav baithaavahu naanak bhav saagar paar utaaraa ||2||58||81||
lines.translation: Please, give me a seat in the boat of the Holy; O Nanak, thus I shall cross over this terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other shore. ||2||58||81||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavai raam saran vadabhaagee ||
lines.translation: One who comes to the Lord's Sanctuary is very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekas bin kichh hor na jaanai avar upaav tiaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He knows of no other than the One Lord. He has renounced all other efforts. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bach kram aaraadhai har har saadhasa(n)g sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: He worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, in thought, word and deed; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anad binod akath kathaa ras saachai sahaj samaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: He enjoys bliss and pleasure, and savors the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; he merges intuitively into the True Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa jo apunaa keeno taa kee ootam baanee ||
lines.translation: Sublime and exalted is the speech of one whom the Lord, in His Mercy makes His Own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੯॥੮੨॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak nisatareeai jo raate prabh nirabaanee ||2||59||82||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with God in the state of Nirvaanaa, O Nanak, are emancipated in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||59||82||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa te saadhoo saran gahee ||
lines.translation: Since I grasped hold of the Sanctuary of the Holy,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj man bhaio pragaasaa birathaa kachh na rahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: my mind is illuminated with tranquility, peace and poise, and I am rid of all my pain. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਏਹ ਕਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hohu kripaal naam dehu apunaa binatee eh kahee ||
lines.translation: Please be merciful to me, O Lord, and bless me with Your Name; this is the prayer I offer to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਇਓ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aan biuhaar bisare prabh simarat paaio laabh sahee ||1||
lines.translation: I have forgotten my other occupations; remembering God in meditation, I have obtained the true profit. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਸਾਈ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah te upajio tahee samaano saaee basat ahee ||
lines.translation: We shall merge again into the One from whom we came; He is the Essence of Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਓ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਹੀ ॥੨॥੬੦॥੮੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoio jotee jot samahee ||2||60||83||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has eradicated my doubt; my light has merged into the Light. ||2||60||83||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa raam ko jas gaau ||
lines.translation: O my tongue, sing the Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਲੋ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan suaad bisaar sagale bhalo naam suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Abandon all other tastes and flavors; the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is so sublime. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal basaai hiradai ek siu liv laau ||
lines.translation: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart; let yourself be lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat hohi niramal bahuR jon na aau ||1||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become immaculate and pure; you shall not come to be reincarnated again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu praan adhaar teraa too nithaave thaau ||
lines.translation: You are the Support of the soul and the breath of life; You are the Home of the homeless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥੬੧॥੮੪॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas samhaal har har naanak sad bal jaau ||2||61||84||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, I dwell on the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||61||84||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baiku(n)th gobi(n)d charan nit dhiaau ||
lines.translation: To meditate on the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe is heaven for me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat padaarath saadhoo sa(n)gat a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the treasure of liberation and the Lord's Ambrosial Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: ootam kathaa suneejai sravanee maiaa karahu bhagavaan ||
lines.translation: O Lord God, please be kind to me, that I may hear with my ears Your Sublime and Exalted Sermon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਦੋਊ ਪਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat dooo pakh pooran paaeeai sukh bisraam ||1||
lines.translation: My cycle of coming and going is finally completed, and I have attained peace and tranquility. ||1||
